Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiments (AP-MS) specifically analyzed proteins captured by PBM or PDZ baits from cell lysates, making the scope 'affinity-purified complex'. While whole cell lysates were used as the starting material, the material actually analyzed by MS was the eluted affinity-purified fraction. Mixed species flag is true because recombinant E. coli proteins (PDZome) were used as baits to capture human proteins.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study contains two distinct proteomics parts: 1) a large-scale fragmentomics affinity mapping (which is a biochemical assay of purified components and not a differential perturbation study of a biological system) and 2) a differential proteome analysis of HEK293T cells expressing HPV16 E6 vs E6ΔPBM vs control. Only the latter is extracted as it represents a biological perturbation comparison.
